DoTranslation moves only at distance >= targetRadius, normalises direction, translates by maxSpeed without elapsed-time multiplication and waits between iterations. No proportional slowing appears in that method.
distance <= arrivalTolerance returns zero steering acceleration. Outside it, decelerationRadius controls target speed and the velocity gap generates limited acceleration; owner velocity is not reset.

specCoverage: Hand-verifiable stride: speed 2 × dt 0.5 = 1. At position 9 the next position is 10; distance 0.5 at position 10 is accepted by radius 0.5, including equality.
The supplied main run is expected to stay at position 10, leaving error 0.5 from target 10.5; it does not snap.
Changing only radius to 0 is expected to alternate positions 10 and 11 with signed velocities 2 and -2, never accepting a sampled place.

Specs additionally cover both radius boundaries, exact target, approach from the far side, crossing a narrower region between samples without acceptance, a region large enough to accept the start, selected text/arithmetic/chart coherence, input reruns, bounds, deterministic output and identical-comparison wording.
